# Donald Trump's job approval falls to 33%

August 11, 2026

Only one-third (33%) of Americans strongly or somewhat approve of how Donald Trump is handling his job as president, according to the latest Economist / YouGov Poll. That's the smallest share to ever approve of Trump's job handling in any Economist / YouGov Poll across both of Trump's terms. Meanwhile 62% disapprove of Trump, the most to ever do so. results.content: POLL WOES: President Donald Trump has fallen out of favor with a majority of Tennessee voters. Only 48 percent said they approved of the way the president is handling his job, and 51 percent disapproved, according to the August 2026 poll conducted by the Beacon Center of Tennessee. Beacon has polled Tennesseans since 2023, and this is the first time those numbers have skewed that way. In the November election, though, Tennessee remains decidedly supportive of Republicans.
